sentences.text:
Date : 05/01/2026 (Michael Zothankhuma, J) Heard Mr. Y. Sikdar, learned counsel for the appellant, who submits that the appellant has been convicted under section 6 of the POCSO Act read with section Page No.# 2/2 376(2) IPC, vide judgement dated 19/11/2025 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum- Special Judge, POCSO, Kamrup (M), Guwahati, in session (Spl)
Case No. 280/2024, arising out of Pragjyotishpur PS Case No. 97/2024.
The appellant was thereafter sentenced under section 6 of the POCSO Act.
Ms. A. Begum, learned APP, Assam, appears on behalf of the State.

The appellant shall submit a soft copy of the appeal petition to the Office of the PP, Assam, who shall thereafter furnish the same to the concerned Officer-in-Charge of the Pragjyotishpur Police Station.
The Officer-in-Charge thereafter furnish the same to the respondent no. 2.
Ms. A. Begum, learned APP, Assam, is granted four weeks' time to file written objection to the application filed under section 430 BNSS.
